name: Video Outreach
intro: Video Outreach lets you record one video and send it to many people, greeting each contact by name, then see who watched and who clicked.

features.record: Every campaign starts with one video. Click Record to capture your screen and camera, or upload a video you already have.
features.script-and-teleprompter: The Script card holds what you'll say, and the teleprompter helps you keep eye contact. Write with AI can draft it for you.
features.clone-your-voice: Clone your voice from your recording, so every contact hears their greeting in your own voice instead of a stock one.
features.greeting-and-fallback: Type a greeting with a first name token, and pick a fallback for contacts missing a name, so everyone gets a warm hello.
features.customize-the-landing-page: Customize the landing page header and message, plus the call to action button and booking link, to turn views into meetings.
features.contacts: Upload a CSV and match your columns, or add contacts one at a time. Each person gets their own personal link.
features.generate-campaign: Generate campaign voices every greeting, publishes your video page and lists every personal link in one go.
features.campaigns: The Campaigns list shows how many contacts watched and clicked, so you know exactly who to follow up with.

outro: That's Video Outreach. One recording, a personal link for every contact, and clear results on who's interested.
